title: The Rough surface of the table
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：rough　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 rough 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the director wrote of ① a rough surface of the table in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② rougher than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it for the whole place and gone home; it was the rough ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the roughest surface of the table anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1983 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too rough to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the rough ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a rough plan for the bridge, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as rough as the plan for the bridge they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was rough or not, and he said so.

By 1996 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something rough, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite rough; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the rough ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1999, without a word of thanks, she wrote of another rough surface of the table in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ rougher than anybody had expected. ⑩ The roughest plan for the bridge in the whole theatre, she said in 2001, was the one she could never quite name; the rough ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 粗糙（前置定语 a rough surface of the table：1989 年导演在戏报里记下的那件粗糙的纹理）
B. adj. 粗糙／粗略（比较级 rougher than：文中两处，一处比桌面粗糙的纹理，一处比预想）
C. adj. 粗糙／粗略（最高级 the roughest：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 粗糙（表语 too rough to do：母亲觉得它太粗糙，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 粗略（前置定语 a rough plan for the bridge：叔叔把整件事称作一桩粗略的初步方案）
F. adj. 粗略（同级比较 as rough as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩造桥的初步方案相比）
G. adj. 粗略（后置定语 something rough：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 粗略（受程度副词修饰 quite rough：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a rough surface of the table
the roughest surface of the table anybody
a rough plan for the bridge
The roughest plan for the bridge in

answers.why: rough 意为“粗糙”，1989 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件粗糙的纹理”，此处作前置定语 a rough surface of the table。
rough 意为“粗糙”，此处用比较级 rougher than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
rough 意为“粗糙”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最粗糙的一件，故用最高级 the roughest surface of the table。
rough 意为“粗糙”，母亲认为这件东西“太粗糙了，谁也用不上”，too rough to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
rough 意为“粗略”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩粗略的初步方案”，此处作前置定语 a rough plan for the bridge。
rough 意为“粗略”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩造桥的初步方案一样粗略”，同级比较用 as rough as。
rough 意为“粗略”，戏报上那半行字要的是“粗略的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something rough。
rough 意为“粗略”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当粗略”，quite 修饰原级 rough。
rough 意为“粗略”，1999 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要粗略”，故用比较级 rougher than。
rough 意为“粗略”，母亲 2001 年说的是“整个戏院里最粗略的那一桩”，故用最高级 the roughest plan for the bridge。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1989 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件粗糙的纹理。（a rough surface of the table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更粗糙。（rougher than …）
母亲觉得它太粗糙，谁也用不上。（too rough to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩粗略的初步方案。（a rough plan for the bridge）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩造桥的初步方案一样粗略。（as rough as …）
到了 1996 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件粗略的东西。（something rough）
answers: In 1989 the director wrote of a rough surface of the table in the poster.
Everybody said it was rougher than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too rough to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a rough plan for the bridge.
He said nobody would call it as rough as the plan for the bridge they had once had.
By 1996 the poster asked for nothing but something rough.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 rough 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the director wrote of a rough surface of the table in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the roughest surface of the table in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too rough to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a rough plan for the bridge, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite rough, and everybody laughed.
The rough ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
